row.notes: Finds the 0x48-byte record keyed param_2 (u16 +2, byte +0) in this+0x2b8..+0x2c0, then for each 8-byte sub-entry (record +0x10..+0x18) scans entities this+0x358..+0x360 (+0x130 == sub key and [+0x120]+0x238 == param_3) and returns the max of float +0x128 over matches whose sub-entry short +4 != -1; 0 when nothing matches.
